reference_sql:
SELECT brand,
       COUNT(*) AS n_products,
       SUM(CASE WHEN launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_products
FROM products
GROUP BY brand
alternatives: SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS n_products, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') AS new_products FROM products GROUP BY brand
SELECT brand, COUNT(product_id) AS n_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN launch_date >= '2025-01-01' AND launch_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 END) AS new_products FROM products GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS n_products, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') AS new_products FROM products GROUP BY brand
other_way.tradeoff: Reads closer to plain English, but FILTER is not available in every SQL dialect.
